why: A continent's allowance per layer (tools/seamcheck.py --check). hard_visible: chunks of hard alpha edge that show on the map; hard_chunks: all of them, shown or not; added_in_footprint: seam chunks the layer adds. *: any layer not named. seams' hard_chunks are its pieces whole on their mirrored lines, by design (they show nothing). sea's are as measured 2026-11-01, not yet looked into.
